description: ZUYRAP crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C50 H46 N4 Nd1 O12 Zn2 1+,C2 H3 O2 1-,C1 H4 O1,H2 O1. From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 10 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.431-3.440 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 100.21-103.08°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links.
